entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems escaping this slump[n]will be difficult on my own...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wish to ask for your help,[n][fName]. Do you think you could[n]listen to what I have to say?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will be waiting in the[n]underground mall in Shibuya.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Did you have other business to[n]attend to? Well, I will ask you[n]again some other time.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I appreciated your help today.[n]Hopefully we can continue to work[n]well together in the future.
